content:
On Jan 26, 2026, Optimism saw significant progress in monorepo consolidation with the migration of `op-alloy` and `op-hardforks`, alongside critical bug fixes for the superchain registry and `op-node`'s yParity calculation. Key discussions continued on `op-deployer` transaction gas limits and `op-batcher` rollup config synchronization, while documentation efforts included a new guide for gas configuration and a "Transaction Fees 101" document.

## 🚨 Needs Attention
- **Urgent Discussions**:
    - `ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io` [#17912](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/17912): User inquired if the "transaction gas limit too high" error for `op-deployer:v0.2.6` has been fixed and which version should be used for alt-da.
    - `ethereum-optimism/op-geth` [#17912](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/17912): Discussion continued on `op-deployer` failing to deploy contracts due to "transaction gas limit too high," with a user asking for fix status and recommended version for alt-da.
    - `ethereum-optimism/design-docs` [#17912](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/design-docs/issues/17912): Discussion continues on the `op-deployer` issue where transactions are failing due to gas limits being too high, with a user inquiring about the fix status and which `op-deployer` version to use for alt-da.
    - `ethereum-optimism/docs` [#17912](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/docs/issues/17912): Discussion continued regarding `op-deployer:v0.2.6` failing to deploy contracts due to "transaction gas limit too high," with a user asking if the issue is fixed and which `op-deployer` version to use for alt-da.
    - `ethereum-optimism/optimism` [#17912](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/17912): Discussion continues on the `op-deployer` issue where transactions fail due to "transaction gas limit too high," with a user asking if the issue is fixed and which `op-deployer` version to use for alt-da.
    - `ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io` [#18178](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/18178): Discussion on `op-batcher`'s inability to re-fetch the rollup config after startup, with a recent suggestion for a critical error and process restart.
    - `ethereum-optimism/op-geth` [#18178](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/18178): Discussion around the `op-batcher` not re-fetching the rollup config after startup continued, with a new suggestion to treat an outdated config as a critical error and restart the batcher.
    - `ethereum-optimism/design-docs` [#18178](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/design-docs/issues/18178): The discussion around the `op-batcher` not staying in sync with the `op-node` rollup config saw a new suggestion to treat out-of-sync as a critical error and restart the process.
    - `ethereum-optimism/docs` [#18178](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/docs/issues/18178): The discussion on `op-batcher` not re-fetching the rollup config after startup continued, with a suggestion to treat this as a critical error and restart the process.
    - `ethereum-optimism/optimism` [#18178](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18178): The issue of `op-batcher` not updating its rollup configuration after initial startup is being actively discussed, with a suggestion to treat an outdated config as a critical error and restart the batcher.
    - `ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io` [#360](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/360): The "Sequencer-Defined Metering Design Doc" issue saw an update expanding its scope to include an initial Proof of Concept (PoC) which is currently blocking the design document.
    - `ethereum-optimism/op-geth` [#360](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/360): The scope of this issue has been expanded to include an initial Proof of Concept (PoC) for Sequencer-Defined Metering, as it is currently blocking the design document's progress.
    - `ethereum-optimism/design-docs` [#360](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/design-docs/issues/360): The scope of the issue to add a Sequencer-Defined Metering Design Doc has been expanded to include an initial Proof of Concept (PoC) which is currently blocking the design document.
    - `ethereum-optimism/docs` [#360](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/docs/issues/360): The "Sequencer-Defined Metering Design Doc" issue saw an update expanding the scope to include the initial Proof of Concept (PoC) as it's currently blocking the design document.
    - `ethereum-optimism/optimism` [#360](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/360): The scope of this issue has been expanded to include an initial Proof of Concept (PoC) for Sequencer-Defined Metering, as it is currently blocking the design document.

## ✅ Completed Work
### Core Component Monorepo Migration
- Upstreamed `op-alloy` into the monorepo, a crucial step for the Rust migration effort. ([ethereum-optimism/optimism#18811](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18811))
- Migrated `op-hardforks` from `alloy-rs/hardforks` into the monorepo. ([ethereum-optimism/optimism#18825](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18825))
- Successfully completed the migration of `kona` and `op-reth` crates into the monorepo. ([ethereum-optimism/optimism#18575](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18575))

### Stability and Safety Enhancements
- Improved the robustness of the superchain registry with better retries and caching mechanisms, preventing CI flakes. ([ethereum-optimism/optimism#18933](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18933))
- Fixed a `uint64` overflow in `op-node`'s yParity calculation by switching to `Uint64Strict` for increased safety. ([ethereum-optimism/optimism#18921](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18921))

### Documentation and Security Updates
- Added a Formal Methods Analysis (FMA) for OPCMv2 to the security documentation, bolstering protocol security. ([ethereum-optimism/design-docs#364](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/design-docs/pull/364))
- Published a guide on changing gas configuration values post-Holocene. ([ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io#1944](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/1944), [ethereum-optimism/op-geth#1944](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/1944), [ethereum-optimism/design-docs#1944](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/design-docs/issues/1944), [ethereum-optimism/docs#1944](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/docs/issues/1944), [ethereum-optimism/optimism#1944](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/1944))
